hero.title: From chaos to insights.
hero.sub: One source of truth your whole team trusts, and analysts who get their week back. Built properly, documented fully, handed over completely. AI where it earns its place, governed from day one.

entries.def: The capacity to act. You regain agency over your data: one source of truth, owned by you and documented for you.
A consulting practice. We design the architecture, build the pipelines and hand everything over. Scope, timeline and costs are agreed before we start.
Agency with AI built in. Adopted in phases, secured and governed from the start. Not a vibe-coded data strategy.

items.text: Your data lives in 5+ different places and nobody can agree on a single source of truth.
Analysts spend 80% of their time cleaning data instead of actually using it.
You're paying for automations but not getting ROI from your AI & cloud investment.

flow.label: How it works
flow.title: One governed flow, from sources to answers.
flow.sub: This is the medallion architecture we build. Every source lands raw, gets cleaned and tested once, and feeds every dashboard and model from the same governed layer.
flow.caption: Sources land in Bronze exactly as they arrive. Silver cleans, conforms and tests. Gold carries the semantic layer that dashboards and AI read.

items.title: Lakehouse architecture
items.desc: One governed source of truth your teams can build on. Delivered as a production-grade lakehouse in Fabric or GCP, with semantic layer, medallion design and governance in Purview or Dataplex from day one.
outcomes: One source of truth your teams trust
Governance and semantic layer from day one

items.title: Pipelines & automation
items.desc: Data that is fresh, tested and ready when your team sits down. Built with dbt on BigQuery or Fabric, orchestrated with Airflow or Fabric pipelines, monitored so quality issues surface before your stakeholders do.

items.title: AI-ready data layers
items.desc: Your ML and BI work starts on day one instead of after months of wrangling. Feature stores, training sets and analytics layers, built with lineage so every number can be traced.

items.title: AI adoption & governance
items.desc: AI that reaches production and earns its keep. A phased rollout with security, access control and evaluation built in, from the first use case onward.
outcomes: A phased roadmap, not a vibe-coded strategy
Security and access control designed in

process.label: No black boxes
process.title: Audit, design, build, handover. You keep the keys and the docs.

about.title: One architect, end to end.
about.body1: data aigency is the remote practice of Vadim Van Den Heuvel. The person who takes your first call is the person who designs the architecture, builds it and hands it over. Nothing is lost between a salesperson and a delivery team.
about.body2: And nothing depends on me staying. Everything lives in your repositories from the first commit, your tables sit in open formats like Delta and Iceberg, and every decision is documented, so any engineer can pick up where I leave off. Scope, timeline and costs are agreed up front. Full handover of code, docs and runbooks. No lock-in, no black boxes.

contact.title: Let's talk about your data stack.
contact.sub: A free 30 minute intake call. We walk through your current stack, the problems you are running into and the solutions worth considering. You leave with a short written summary, whether we work together or not. No deck, no obligations.
